about: Declared before remediation-v1 was trained or evaluated; the primary target was changed (version 2, see 'changed') before any real evaluation. Graded by t3/evals/graders.py (network level) and t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1 (per cell), both by twin replay against the same-step healthy counterfactual; no model grades another. The episode, tolerances, material gaps and bootstrap are t3/evals/targets.json's.

primary.what: the 18 masked incidents of the frozen test split (t3/evals/suite/incidents-test.jsonl); v1 and ppo_sm_50k graded identically
primary.rule: PASS only if all three components pass. Each component is a paired-bootstrap lower bound that must be above its own threshold; the unit's value is the smallest margin (ci_low minus threshold), so value > 0 if and only if all three pass. tools/check_unit.py part e replays every component (JOINT_METRIC).

components.name: percell_recovered
components.what: item score = percell_recovered(v1) - percell_recovered(ppo_sm_50k), each 1 or 0: t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1, every cell green against its own healthy state at the grade step

components.name: network_recovery_noninferior
components.what: recovery(v1) - recovery(ppo_sm_50k), network level (t3/evals/graders.py, capped at 1.0): v1 may be at most 0.05 worse (non-inferiority)

primary.item_score: percell_recovered(v1) - percell_recovered(ppo_sm_50k); extra.diff holds all three component differences
primary.interval: paired-bootstrap-v1 over item ids, subset extra.suite = test-masked, t3/evals/targets.json bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261102, 95%)
primary.replication: the same three components are reported on test-visible, confirm and dev-holdout; they are not part of pass/fail

suites.confirm: frozen confirmation suite t3/evals/suite/incidents-confirm.jsonl (18 masked, fresh seeds 990003-990271)
suites.dev-holdout: role=holdout candidates of t1/rl/remediation/candidates.jsonl in index order, the first 100 that incidents.build keeps on the job's platform (never trained on)

secondary_measures.recovery: t3/evals/graders.py recovery at the grade step (mean over material KPIs)
secondary_measures.success: every graded KPI within tolerance of the same-step healthy counterfactual
secondary_measures.diagnosis_hit: the cell with the largest applied change (|d_power_db|/6 + |d_tilt_deg|/5) in the operator's first non-empty applied step is a faulted cell; no applied change at all is a miss
secondary_measures.cells_touched: distinct cells with a non-zero applied (safety-filtered) delta over the three operator steps
secondary_measures.total_abs_power_db: sum over operator steps and cells of |applied d_power_db|
secondary_measures.total_abs_tilt_deg: sum over operator steps and cells of |applied d_tilt_deg|
secondary_measures.headroom_used: energy proxy at the grade step: sum over cells of max(0, final power - commissioned power) divided by sum over cells of (power_max_dbm - commissioned power); 0 = no cell above its healthy power
secondary_measures.power_above_healthy_db: the numerator of headroom_used, in dB
secondary_measures.healthy_false_change: on the same network without the fault (commissioning only, state before the first operator step), the operator proposes a change
secondary_measures.reporting: per suite and operator: means and counts; paired-bootstrap intervals of v1 minus each baseline (same parameters as the primary) for every measure above. Only the primary (joint) is a target.
secondary_measures.percell_recovered: t3/evals/percell.py percell-v1: every cell green against its own healthy state at the grade step
secondary_measures.percell_degraded_cells: number of cells not green against their own healthy state at the grade step (percell-v1)
secondary_measures.percell_collateral_cells: number of non-faulted cells that end degraded AND worse than right before the first operator step (percell-v1)

changed.data_seen: only a synthetic pipeline smoke: 5 test-masked incidents, scored by a model trained on 18 incidents (not a claim). No real remediation-v1 model existed; training job t1-rl-remediation-train-20261104T073837Z-664093 was still running.
changed.reason: network-level recovery is capped at 1.0 and rewards overshoot: in Live Fix run t3.livefix-20261104T073206Z-9695 the governed swarm (its change proposed by ppo_sm_50k) scored network recovery 1.00 while cells 0 and 3 stayed degraded, with 14.1 dB of power above healthy. t3/evals/tests/test_percell.py reproduces that run. Under version 1 a targeted fix could not beat an overshooting one even when it restores every cell.
changed.decided_with: the team lead (the user), 4 Nov ~00:00 PST

previous_primary.what: the 18 masked incidents of the frozen test split (t3/evals/suite/incidents-test.jsonl)
previous_primary.item_score: recovery(v1) - recovery(ppo_sm_50k) on the same incident (the run's items hold the differences)
previous_primary.interval: paired-bootstrap-v1 over item ids, subset extra.suite = test-masked, t3/evals/targets.json bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261102, 95%)
